newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SMART CENTRE DETAILS CAPITALISATION AWARD.
newsitem.headline: SMART CENTRE DETAILS CAPITALISATION AWARD.

text.p: South African fashion retailer Smart Centre Holdings Ltd on Tuesday detailed its capitalisation share award.
The firm said shareholders representing 40,382 new ordinary shares had elected to receive 920 cents in cash a share. The total sum to be paid by holding firm Pepkor Ltd is 371,516 rand.
A total of 867,543 shares had been allotted to the share award scheme. The listing of the capitalisation ordinary shares will take place from the start of trading on October 16.
